verdict.rationale: File converters are often cloud services where region choice matters, so this axis applies. Filee's own docs say nothing is uploaded and it works offline, so files never leave the user's computer: residency is wherever the user keeps them. Watch folders and the portable install also let users choose local locations. Missing for 10: explicit documentation framing this as data-residency control, and independent or hands-on confirmation that no network transfer of user files occurs.
